schemes.name: Integrated Rural Education Support Grant
schemes.short_description: Operational assistance and learning kits for non-profits running community remedial education centers.
schemes.full_description: This initiative supports grassroots non-profit organizations operating community learning centers and after-school remedial tutoring for underprivileged children in rural and semi-urban blocks. The grant covers operational honorariums for local educators, learning materials, and digital classroom kits.
schemes.eligibility_criteria: [{"id":"crit-01-sec","category":"sector","label":"Focus Sector Alignment","requirementDescription":"Organization must have primary or secondary focus in Education or Rural Development."},{"id":"crit-01-loc","category":"location","label":"Geographic Presence","requirementDescription":"Operating presence in identified rural or semi-urban blocks within covered states."},{"id":"crit-01-stat","category":"statutory","label":"NGO Darpan Registration","requirementDescription":"Active registration on the NITI Aayog NGO Darpan portal."},{"id":"crit-01-exp","category":"experience","label":"Operational Track Record","requirementDescription":"Minimum 2 years of continuous grassroots operations in education or community welfare."},{"id":"crit-01-aud","category":"audit","label":"Financial Audit","requirementDescription":"Submission of audited balance sheets and annual reports for the previous 2 financial years."}]
schemes.required_documents: ["NGO Darpan Registration Certificate","Trust Deed / Society Registration Certificate","12A & 80G Tax Exemption Certificates","Audited Financial Statements (Last 2 Years)","List of Current Governing Body Members"]
schemes.application_process: ["Verify Darpan ID and statutory certificates in your NGO Profile.","Prepare project proposal detailing target learning centers and student count.","Submit the preliminary grant application on the designated state nodal portal.","District Education Officer conducts field verification of learning premises.","Grant disbursement in two tranches upon milestone approval."]
schemes.official_source: Prototype Sample Data • Inspired by Central Department of School Education guidelines

schemes.name: Grassroots Community Health Worker Subsidy
schemes.short_description: Honorarium subsidies and mobile diagnostic kit grants for maternal and infant nutrition outreach.
schemes.full_description: A program supporting registered non-profits providing primary health camps, maternal health tracking, and child immunization mobilization in aspirational districts.
schemes.eligibility_criteria: [{"id":"crit-02-sec","category":"sector","label":"Health Focus Domain","requirementDescription":"Organization must be actively engaged in primary healthcare or nutrition outreach."},{"id":"crit-02-loc","category":"location","label":"Target District Coverage","requirementDescription":"Operating within aspirational or priority rural health blocks."},{"id":"crit-02-stat","category":"statutory","label":"Valid NGO Registration","requirementDescription":"Valid Darpan ID and registered society or trust bylaws allowing medical relief."},{"id":"crit-02-aud","category":"audit","label":"Audit & Compliance","requirementDescription":"Clean audit compliance with no pending statutory defaults."}]
schemes.required_documents: ["NGO Darpan Certificate","Paramedic / Medical Staff Verification Credentials","Past Year Health Camp Field Reports","12A Registration Order"]
schemes.application_process: ["Submit roster of community health volunteers and target villages.","Chief Medical Officer (CMO) endorsement and baseline assessment.","Quarterly performance review and diagnostic kit replenishment."]
schemes.official_source: Prototype Sample Data • Inspired by NHM outreach frameworks

schemes.name: Women Self-Help Group Livelihood Enterprise Fund
schemes.short_description: Revolving fund grants and enterprise toolkits for federating rural women micro-enterprises.
schemes.full_description: Facilitates capacity building, market linkages, and seed capital for women-led self-help groups (SHGs) engaged in agro-processing, handloom, and sustainable village crafts.
schemes.eligibility_criteria: [{"id":"crit-03-sec","category":"sector","label":"Women Empowerment & Livelihood","requirementDescription":"Focus on women empowerment, livelihood generation, or micro-finance."},{"id":"crit-03-stat","category":"statutory","label":"Darpan & 12A/80G","requirementDescription":"Valid Darpan ID and valid income tax exemption."},{"id":"crit-03-exp","category":"experience","label":"SHG Mobilization Experience","requirementDescription":"Minimum 50 SHGs mobilized or mentored in the preceding 12 months."}]
schemes.required_documents: ["SHG Federation List & Bank Account Details","NGO Darpan Certificate & PAN","Annual Activity Report","80G & 12A Tax Orders"]
schemes.application_process: ["Online submission of SHG cluster profile and business plan.","District Rural Development Agency (DRDA) verification.","Direct disbursement to SHG cluster accounts."]
schemes.official_source: Prototype Sample Data • Inspired by NRLM livelihood schemes

schemes.name: Decentralized Clean Water Quality Monitoring Aid
schemes.short_description: Field testing equipment and community training aid for rural drinking water surveillance.
schemes.full_description: Provides water testing field kits, bacterial test vials, and training honorariums to local non-profits monitoring potability of community water sources.
schemes.eligibility_criteria: [{"id":"crit-04-sec","category":"sector","label":"Water & Rural Sanitation Focus","requirementDescription":"Working in rural development, water resources, or public sanitation."},{"id":"crit-04-loc","category":"location","label":"State Eligibility","requirementDescription":"Operating within eligible northern and western water-stressed blocks."},{"id":"crit-04-stat","category":"statutory","label":"Darpan ID","requirementDescription":"Valid NGO Darpan registration."}]
schemes.required_documents: ["NGO Registration Certificate","Darpan Registration ID","MoU or Letter of Support from target Gram Panchayats"]
schemes.application_process: ["Register target village water points.","Collect test kit supply from district lab.","Upload monthly water quality testing logs."]
schemes.official_source: Prototype Sample Data • Inspired by Jal Jeevan Mission guidelines

schemes.name: Youth Skill & Vocational Training Placement Grant
schemes.short_description: Per-trainee subsidies for non-profits running market-aligned vocational skilling centers.
schemes.full_description: Assists non-profits providing certified technical skilling in solar installation, data entry, healthcare assistance, and hospitality with verifiable employment placement support.
schemes.eligibility_criteria: [{"id":"crit-05-sec","category":"sector","label":"Vocational Training Track","requirementDescription":"Active training infrastructure or accredited course curriculum."},{"id":"crit-05-stat","category":"statutory","label":"Darpan & 12A","requirementDescription":"Valid Darpan and 12A registration."},{"id":"crit-05-exp","category":"experience","label":"Placement Commitment","requirementDescription":"Demonstrated capacity to place at least 70% of certified batches."}]
schemes.required_documents: ["Center Infrastructure Photos & Lease Deed","Trainer Qualification Certifications","Past Batch Placement Audit Records","Darpan & Tax Exemption Certificates"]
schemes.application_process: ["Accreditation of training syllabus by Sector Skill Council.","Batch enrollment through SahaySetu portal.","Assessment by third-party agency and direct milestone release."]

schemes.name: Community Afforestation & Watershed Conservation Aid
schemes.short_description: Project grants for non-profits restoring degraded village commons, soil health, and native tree cover.
schemes.full_description: Supports local environmental societies engaged in rainwater harvesting structures, community tree nurseries, and agro-forestry promotion on degraded community lands.
schemes.department: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
schemes.eligibility_criteria: [{"id":"crit-06-sec","category":"sector","label":"Environmental Focus","requirementDescription":"Demonstrated work in forestry, soil conservation, or ecological restoration."},{"id":"crit-06-stat","category":"statutory","label":"Darpan & Governance","requirementDescription":"Active Darpan ID with at least 3 years since registration."}]
schemes.required_documents: ["Detailed Project Report (DPR) with GPS coordinates","Gram Sabha Resolution approving conservation work","3-Year Audited Balance Sheets"]
schemes.application_process: ["Submission of DPR and boundary maps.","State Forest Department technical appraisal.","Tranche releases linked to geotagged tree survival audit."]

schemes.name: Accessible Learning Aids & Assistive Devices Support
schemes.short_description: Subsidies for organizations manufacturing or distributing prosthetic and learning aids for disabled persons.
schemes.full_description: Assists disability welfare non-profits in organizing assessment camps and fitting custom assistive aids, wheelchairs, hearing devices, and braille learning kits for persons with disabilities.
schemes.department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
schemes.eligibility_criteria: [{"id":"crit-07-sec","category":"sector","label":"Disability Welfare Mandate","requirementDescription":"Mandate in rehabilitation, special education, or disability support."},{"id":"crit-07-stat","category":"statutory","label":"RPwD Act Registration","requirementDescription":"Registration under Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act or National Trust."}]
schemes.required_documents: ["RPwD / State Disability Department Registration","NGO Darpan Certificate","Rehabilitation Professional Council Credentials of Staff"]
schemes.application_process: ["Apply with list of identified beneficiaries.","District disability committee vetting.","Distribution camp organized with nodal agency officials."]

schemes.name: Integrated Child Protection & Care Home Grant
schemes.short_description: Maintenance and nutritional support for non-profits running shelter homes and child daycare centers.
schemes.full_description: Provides per-child monthly maintenance grants, counseling aid, and health checkup subsidies for registered children homes, orphanages, and open shelters for vulnerable children.
schemes.department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.eligibility_criteria: [{"id":"crit-08-sec","category":"sector","label":"Child Protection Mandate","requirementDescription":"Specialized in child care, early education, or shelter management."},{"id":"crit-08-stat","category":"statutory","label":"Juvenile Justice (JJ) Act Registration","requirementDescription":"Mandatory registration under Juvenile Justice Act with State Child Protection Society."},{"id":"crit-08-aud","category":"audit","label":"Financial Audit","requirementDescription":"Clean audit for past 3 years with zero compliance infractions."}]
schemes.required_documents: ["JJ Act Fit Facility Certificate","Child Welfare Committee (CWC) Inspection Report","Fire & Building Safety Compliance Certificates","3-Year Audited Accounts & Darpan Certificate"]
schemes.application_process: ["Submit facility capacity details and staff background checks.","Joint inspection by District Child Protection Unit (DCPU).","Monthly grant disbursed directly to institutional account."]
